# Current data for `r params$SITE` 

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r init}
#| include: false

library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
theme_set(theme_bw())
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

site <- params$SITE
dropbox <- params$DROPBOX
current <- "current_data"

read_files <- function(type, site = params$SITE, path = params$DROPBOX) {
  if(site %in% c("PTR", "CRC", "OWC", "SWH", "GWI", "MSM", "GCW", "DLG")) {
    subpath <- "COMPASS_PNNL_Data"
  } else if(site %in% c("TMP")) {
    subpath <- "TEMPEST_PNNL_Data"
    current <- "Current_data" # you're killing me, Roy
  } else {
    stop("Unknown site: ", site)
  }
  files <- list.files(file.path(path, subpath, current), 
                      pattern = paste0("_", site, "_.*_", type),
                      full.names = TRUE)
  message("Found ", length(files), " files")
  
  x <- lapply(files, function(f) {
    message(basename(f))
    txt <- read_lines(f)
    read_csv(I(txt[c(-1, -3, -4)]), show_col_types = FALSE)
  })
  names(x) <- basename(files)
  x %>% 
    bind_rows() %>% 
    pivot_longer(-1:-4)
}

```

## Sapflow

```{r}
read_files("Sapflow") %>% 
  filter(name != "BattV_Avg") %>%  # probably we don't care about this
  separate(Statname, into = c("X", "Site", "Plot")) %>% 
  mutate(port = gsub("DiffVolt._Avg\\(", "", name),
         port = as.integer(gsub(")", "", port)),
         port = as.factor(port)) -> 
  sf
message("sf has ", nrow(sf), " rows")

p <- ggplot(sf, aes(TIMESTAMP, value, color = port)) +
  facet_grid(Plot ~ .) +
  geom_point(na.rm = TRUE)
print(p)

p <- p + ylim(c(0, 1)) + ggtitle("Data in 0-1 range only")
print(p)
```
